matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: An hourglass network is used as the backbone to predict heatmaps and embeddings used for keypoint grouping.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The hourglass network is crucial to the performance of CornerNet.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: CornerNet detects bounding boxes by predicting paired top-left and bottom-right keypoints, eliminating the need for anchor boxes.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: CornerNet eliminates the need for designing anchor boxes used in prior single-stage detectors.

unmatched_a.a_claim_text_normalized: Anchor box design introduces many hyperparameters and a large mismatch between positive and negative samples that the keypoint formulation avoids.
